item.title: Trump Administration Steps Up Midterm Interventions, and Israeli Elections Have No Clear Winner
item.description:
Plus, the Friday news quiz. 

Here’s what we’re covering:

  • Republicans Ramp Up Investigation Into Democratic Plan to Pack Alaska’s Ballot, by Kellen Browning, Anna Griffin and Glenn Thrush
  • Justice Dept. Pressures California With Expanded Election Investigation, by Devlin Barrett and Shawn Hubler
  • Hegseth Fires General He Accused of Leaking Information to the News Media, by Greg Jaffe
  • Final Vote Results in Israel Set Up Weeks of Uncertainty About Who Will Govern, by Leo Sands, Johnatan Reiss and Ephrat Livni
